Money.title: Decimal Money
Money.description: Canonical decimal-safe money representation. No binary floating-point. Amount is a canonical decimal string.

amount.description: Canonical decimal string. No scientific notation, no leading zeros (except single '0'), no trailing zeros unless significant, no sign. Maximum 18 decimal places.

network.description: Payment network identifier (e.g., 'base-mainnet', 'base-sepolia'). Optional for non-payment contexts.

asset.description: Payment asset identifier (e.g., 'USDC', 'ETH'). Optional for non-payment contexts.

precision.description: Maximum decimal places supported by the asset/network. Metadata only.

RequestEnvelope.title: Service Request Envelope
RequestEnvelope.description: Common request envelope for all SITEBORNE service invocations. Wraps service-specific input payload.

request_id.description: Unique request identifier. Must be a valid UUID v4 or ULID.

service_id.description: Canonical service identifier. Must match the target service schema.

service_version.description: Explicit service version. Must match the service schema version.

response_schema_version.description: Expected output schema version. Allows forward-compatible evolution.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated idempotency key for exactly-once semantics. Required for paid operations.

freshness_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable age of cached data in seconds. 0 = no cache. Bounded to prevent stale data.

minimum_verification_score.description: Minimum PCC verification score required for the result to be accepted. Range [0, 1].

buyer_metadata.description: Optional buyer-provided metadata that cannot alter execution policy, pricing, or security constraints.

input.description: Service-specific input payload. Schema determined by service_id.

extensions.description: Reverse-domain qualified extensions per PCC 1.0.0 rules.

QuoteRequest.title: Quote Request
QuoteRequest.description: Request for a price quote for a service execution. Used for pre-authorization and cost estimation.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalized input payload that will be executed.

input_schema_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the input schema that validates the input.

output_schema_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the output schema that will validate the result.

requested_pricing_scheme.description: Pricing scheme requested for the quote.

QuoteResponse.title: Quote Response
QuoteResponse.description: Price quote for a service execution. Includes pricing details, validity, and execution metadata.

expires_at.description: Quote expiration timestamp (RFC 3339 UTC). Must be after issued_at.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the input payload.

input_schema_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the input schema.

output_schema_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the output schema.

pricing_policy_version.description: Pricing policy version used for this quote.

expected_completeness.description: Expected completeness score for the result.

declared_limitations.description: Declared limitations of the quoted service.

production_enabled.description: Whether the service is production-enabled. Must be false for SUN-0101.

payment_required.description: Whether payment is required for execution.

StructuredError.title: Structured Error
StructuredError.description: Canonical structured error envelope for all SITEBORNE services. Machine-actionable, no secrets, no stack traces.

message.description: Human-readable descriptive message. Not authoritative for machine control.

retryable.description: Whether the operation may succeed on retry without caller changes.

failed_field_paths.description: Bounded field paths that failed validation (JSON Pointer format).

limitations.description: Known limitations related to this error.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds before retry is recommended. Only when meaningful.

original_receipt_reference.description: Original receipt reference for idempotent replay scenarios.

quarantine_reason.description: Reason for quarantine if category is quarantined.

extensions.description: Reverse-domain qualified extensions per PCC rules.

ServiceMetadata.title: Service Metadata
ServiceMetadata.description: Machine-readable service metadata for discovery, pricing, and capability advertisement.

description.description: Literal capability description. No promotional language.

input_schema_uri.description: URI to the input schema (relative or absolute).

input_schema_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical input schema.

output_schema_uri.description: URI to the output schema (relative or absolute).

output_schema_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical output schema.

pcc_version.description: PCC version this service conforms to.

maximum_input_bytes.description: Maximum input payload size in bytes.

expected_latency_class.description: Expected latency class for sync execution.

production_enabled.description: Whether the service is production-enabled. Must be false for SUN-0101.

AsyncJob.title: Async Job
AsyncJob.description: Async job representation for long-running service executions. Does not imply queue/database implementation.

poll_after_seconds.description: Recommended seconds before next status poll.

result_reference.description: Reference to result artifact (e.g., R2 key, artifact ID).

receipt_reference.description: PCC receipt reference for delivered jobs.

Pagination.title: Pagination
Pagination.description: Standard pagination controls for list-based service outputs.

total_items.description: Total number of items across all pages.

AuthorizedArtifactReference.title: Authorized Artifact Reference
AuthorizedArtifactReference.description: Reference to an authorized document artifact for processing. Used for document evidence service.

artifact_id.description: Unique artifact identifier (e.g., R2 object key, artifact registry ID).

media_type.description: Declared MIME type of the artifact.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 content hash for integrity verification.

access_token.description: Short-lived access token for private artifacts. Must not be logged.

PCCDocument.title: Proof-Carrying Context (PCC) v1.0.0
PCCDocument.description: Normative schema for Proof-Carrying Context 1.0.0. Frozen after compatibility validation passes. Schema patch 1.0.1 (SUN-0100 correction): extension_container now structurally permits qualified extension keys via patternProperties, matching documented semantics; pcc_version (document content compatibility) is unchanged at 1.0.0. Schema minor 1.1.0 (SUN-1000 checkpoint 1M): service_id enum gains 4 new .v2 members (additive-only per packages/pcc-schema/policy/COMPATIBILITY.md section 1/section 4, which explicitly classifies new enum values as minor-compatible -- not the docs/contracts/COMPATIBILITY_POLICY.md service-contract-release taxonomy, which does not govern this file); the 4 existing .v1 members are unchanged and remain valid; pcc_version is unchanged at 1.0.0.

timestamp_rfc3339.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with Z suffix, normalized fractional seconds

decimal_string.description: Non-negative decimal string, no scientific notation, no leading zeros except single zero

extension_container.description: Controlled extension container. Keys must use reverse-domain qualified namespaces with at least three DNS-safe labels (e.g., net.siteborne.verification.v1, com.example.custom-metrics.v1). Underscores, leading/trailing hyphens, empty labels, and uppercase are forbidden. Maximum 10 extensions. Maximum total namespace key length: 253 characters. Each value must conform to extension_value (bounded JSON data).

extension_value.description: Bounded JSON data payload for a single namespaced extension (PCC 1.0.1). Must be a JSON object; unbounded, executable, or policy-changing structures are out of scope for structural validation. Individual services may further narrow this shape for their own namespace via allOf composition.
